title: The Second Invitation
fact_notes: オリジナル論説・架空事例。実在の人物、学校、調査結果ではない。台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: When a new student joins a club, the members invite her to take part in an activity after school.
sentences.ja: 新しい生徒が部に入ると、部員たちは放課後の活動に参加するよう誘う。

sentences.en: She politely refuses the invitation and explains that she has another responsibility that afternoon.
sentences.ja: 彼女は丁寧に誘いを断り、その午後には別の責任があると説明する。

sentences.en: Some members assume that she is not interested in spending time with them outside their regular meetings.
sentences.ja: 部員の一部は、定例会以外で一緒に過ごすことに彼女が興味を持たないと思う。

sentences.en: Consequently, they hesitate to invite her to similar activities in the future.
sentences.ja: そこで今後同様の活動に誘うのをためらう。

sentences.en: Another member notices that the new student often contributes useful ideas during club meetings.
sentences.ja: 別の部員は新入部員が会合中によく有用な考えを出すことに気づく。

sentences.en: He wonders whether her earlier refusal actually indicated a general preference or simply reflected the circumstances of one particular day.
sentences.ja: 以前の断りが実際に一般的な好みを示したのか、単に特定の日の事情を反映したのか疑問に思う。

sentences.en: He decides to ask her about the kind of activities she would enjoy and the times that would be convenient for her.
sentences.ja: どんな活動を楽しめるか、都合のよい時間はいつか尋ねることにする。

sentences.en: She explains that she sometimes needs to help her family but would like to participate when she is available.
sentences.ja: 時には家族の手伝いが必要だが都合のよい時には参加したいと説明する。

sentences.en: The club members discuss how they can communicate their invitations without making anyone feel pressured to accept them.
sentences.ja: 誰にも承諾の圧力を感じさせずに誘いを伝える方法を話し合う。

sentences.en: They decide to announce optional activities to everyone and make clear that participation is not required.
sentences.ja: 任意活動を全員に知らせ、参加は必須でないことを明示することにする。

sentences.en: They also agree to avoid interpreting a single refusal as a permanent decision about future activities.
sentences.ja: 一度断られたことを将来の活動についての永続的判断と解釈しないことにも同意する。

sentences.en: This approach gives members an opportunity to consider each invitation according to their own circumstances.
sentences.ja: この方法は各部員が自身の事情に応じて各誘いを考える機会を与える。

sentences.en: The new student eventually joins a weekend activity that suits her schedule.
sentences.ja: 新入部員はやがて日程に合う週末活動に参加する。

sentences.en: She enjoys the experience, although she continues to decline some other invitations.
sentences.ja: 経験を楽しむが、他の誘いの一部は引き続き断る。

sentences.en: The club members learn that participation can vary without necessarily indicating a change in someone's interest.
sentences.ja: 参加が変動しても必ずしも関心の変化を示さないと部員たちは学ぶ。

sentences.en: They begin paying more attention to the practical conditions that make participation possible.
sentences.ja: 参加を可能にする実務条件により注意を払うようになる。

sentences.en: A single response does not always reveal a person's general intentions.
sentences.ja: 一つの返答が常に人の一般的意図を明らかにするわけではない。

sentences.en: An invitation can remain welcoming even when it is declined.
sentences.ja: 誘いは断られても歓迎の気持ちを保ち得る。

sentences.en: Respect involves accepting someone's answer while remaining open to what may be different next time.
sentences.ja: 尊重には相手の返答を受け入れつつ次回異なるかもしれないことに心を開いておくことが伴う。

sentences.en: The second invitation becomes a way of offering an opportunity rather than demanding a particular response.
sentences.ja: 二度目の誘いは特定返答を要求するのでなく機会を提供する方法になる。

vocabulary.definition: thing one is expected to do
relating to time yet to come
thinks about whether something is true
in a way that must occur

questions.prompt: Why does the new student refuse?
options: She has another responsibility that afternoon.
She has not received the invitation.

questions.prompt: What assumption do some members make?
options: She wants every activity to be held at school.
She has already accepted another invitation.
One refusal indicates a general lack of interest.

questions.prompt: What does the other member notice?
options: She contributes useful ideas during meetings.
She prefers not to talk to anyone.
The club must change every activity for her.
He wants to end regular meetings.
Her ability to join may depend on her schedule.
Her earlier answer establishes all future availability.
questions.explanation_ja: 事情による参加可能性。

questions.prompt: How will optional activities be announced?
options: Only to members who previously accepted.
To everyone, with participation clearly voluntary.
Only after everyone has agreed to attend.
questions.explanation_ja: 全員に任意活動として告知。

questions.prompt: How does this approach reduce pressure?
options: It requires everyone to give the same answer.
It removes every opportunity to join.
Members can consider each invitation separately.

questions.prompt: When does the student eventually join an activity?

options: Interest and actual participation need not change together.
She no longer has family responsibilities.
Every invitation must be accepted eventually.
The club should stop offering activities.

questions.prompt: What does permanent mean in paragraph 3?

options: A person who refuses once should not be invited again.
Respectful invitations allow people to decline without losing future opportunities.
Every invitation should create a duty to participate.
People must explain all personal responsibilities before refusing.
questions.explanation_ja: 断りを尊重し次の機会も開く。

paraphrases.source: The club members discuss how they can communicate their invitations without making anyone feel pressured to accept them.
paraphrases.rewrite: They seek a way to invite members without pressuring them.

paraphrases.source: Respect involves accepting someone's answer while remaining open to what may be different next time.
paraphrases.rewrite: Respect means accepting an answer without ruling out future opportunities.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 返答尊重と将来への開放。

discourse.role_ja: 思い込みから誘いを控える。
家族の責任と参加意欲。
参加できる時と断る時。

cloze.explanation_ja: 一般的な好みかどうか。
